APPLY NOW
What is the institutional code for sending official GRE scores?
Answer: 2530
What is the target date for application?
Answer:
Fall: January 15
Spring: November 1
Applications completed by these target dates will normally receive decisions by early
April for Fall matriculation and by early December for Spring matriculation.
What is the mailing address for the graduate school application and supporting documents
if they are not submitted online?
Answer:
Office of Instruction & Graduate Studies
SUNY ESF
One Forestry Drive, 227 Bray Hall
Syracuse, NY 13210
Where can I find the online application forms?
Answer: This is a link to the online application form..
What kind of assistantships are available through the chemistry graduate program?
Answer: With a teaching or research assistantship, PhD students receive tuition waivers and
stipends. Students are usually supported during their first and second academic year
as teaching assistants. Students are typically supported by research grants or fellowships
during summers, and in subsequent academic years. No assistantships are available
for MS or MPS students.
What type of stipends are included with assistantships?
Answer: Academic year stipends are at least $18,000, with additional support available for
summer. PhD students should earn $20,000 per calendar year. These stipends easily
cover the cost of living in Syracuse.
What additional awards are available?
Answer: The Chemistry Department gives out thousands of dollars in awards each year.
Awards List
Can ESF graduate students take courses at Syracuse University (SU)?
Answer: Yes! Students may take courses at SU that are relevant to their program of
study. There is a fee associated with these courses. Please consult your major professor
for more information.
Where can I find information on the Syracuse community?
Answer: This is a link to information about Syracuse and the SUNY ESF community.
Where can international students find more information?
Answer: See the ESF Office of International Education or email [email protected]
What student groups are available?
Answer: ESF student organizations, and ESF students can participate in student organizations at Syracuse University.
Is there an organization that represents graduate students on campus?
Answer: Yes. The Graduate Student Organization (GSA) represents graduate students at SUNY
ESF. GSA officers and representatives from each department are elected each Spring.
Visit the GSA website for more information.
Where can I find information about housing in Syracuse?
Answer: Housing is available both on and off-campus for graduate students. Please contact
the Office of Residence Life at Syracuse University at (315) 443-3637 or email at
[email protected] for more information about on-campus graduate student housing. Additionally, local
housing websites like Orange Housing are good resources for off-campus housing.
Is health insurance included as part of the research and teaching assistantships?
Answer: Yes, and it is excellent!
What are the requirements for MS and PhD students in chemistry?
Answer: MS and PhD students must specialize in one of four areas:
Biochemistry
Environmental Chemistry
Organic Chemistry of Natural Products
Polymer Chemistry
More information may be found here.
What are the requirements for MPS students in chemistry?
Answer: MPS students take 30 credits, of which at least 24 credits are for coursework and
3 credits are for an integrative experience (internship, research, or independent
study). More complete explanations may be found here in the information for current graduate students.
